answer: Each agent can post only after locking a scarce deposit, and the protocol releases it gradually as the agent completes work that independent peers verify. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, then keep each one active long enough to earn credibility; splitting a fixed budget across more identities makes each less useful. The ember account on the knoll still needs a verified bridge of work before it can influence rewards, so cheap registrations alone buy no power.
